name: Dennis Pilarinos
bio: Dennis Pilarinos is the founder and CEO of buddybuild, a continuous integration, delivery and user feedback platform that is designed, built and optimized specifically for mobile app developers. Prior to buddybuild, Dennis held product and engineering leadership roles at Amazon building and running the teams responsible for the Silk Web browser UI for the Kindle Fire Tablet and Fire Phone devices. Prior to his time at Amazon, he spent 9 years at Microsoft and founded the Azure teams focused on defining, building, delivering and operating the Messaging, Access Control and Workflow offerings of Microsoft's cloud services platform.
